Love this phone - and I SOOO appreciate the seller. Okay- so this phone started out as a bit of a struggle. Not going to lie. HOWEVER, though the support of the seller and my own willingness to work with the seller through some issues, this has ended on an extremely high note. I purchased this phone to replace my extremely glitchy cheapo Motorola, that's not even a year old but already has some serious touch digitizer and freezing issues. Motorola- your Moto Power is crap. 'Nuff said. My mom encouraged me to buy this Samsung Galaxy S9+ phone, because she's had one for 6 YEARS now, and has loved it and has never had any issues with it. Small problem: they no longer manufacture this phone. Sad panda. So, I went online and purchased a renewed phone. Big mistake- turns out "renewed" phones have original electronics/batteries and ports.

Works great but box has been opened. Product has worked well so far in my initial testing and setting up. I am able to register it to my Samsung account as an additional device. More to test but would like to note the following for future buyers if these should be a concern: Product looked like it came in original box with seal unbroken. But upon carefully peeling off the seal instead of just cutting it open, I discovered the original seal underneath which indicated that the box has already been opened before. You can see the adhesive from the large sticker covering the broken seal. The box specified that the product was manufactured in Vietnam. If box has been opened or this is a refurbished unit, I think the seller should note it instead of not being truthful about this.
great phone, great seller. seller is honest and product is perfect. Had no issues arrived early on time and un damaged. I would purchase from this seller again

Works but issues. I bought this phone for my mother who is on Cricket (part of at&t) it gives me an internal error message that it can not complete activation. When I called cricket, the rep said everything is working fine on their end and that the phone was activated. She was able to make and receive calls but text messages, not so much. She could send but only received 1 or 2 out of a dozen sent from various phones. After a factory reset, I still get the internal error message of activation not complete but now she is able to at least receive text messages. I contacted Cricket again and they are saying its a Samsung issue. I've updated the software but its still giving me an error.
